# QRDY Documentation

> QRDY provides powerful tools for Canva users and general productivity. This documentation covers Image to Frames (custom frame creation for Canva), Text to Frames (fill text with images in Canva), Calendar Maker (generate calendars in Canva), and NoteMe (note-taking and reminder system).

## About Image to Frames

Image to Frames is a Canva app that instantly converts any image (PNG, JPG, or SVG) into a custom frame. Users can convert images with one click, browse 40,000+ premium frames and growing, or create their own custom frames. Perfect for social media posts, map art, text to frames, double exposure effects, and more.

**Key Features:**
- One-click image to frame conversion
- Access to 40,000+ premium frames and growing
- Three ways to use: tap image in Canva, upload file, or import from frame library
- Fully automatic conversion - no manual editing needed
- Supports PNG, SVG, and JPG formats
- Pro subscription required for all features

## Important Information

**Pro Subscription:**
- Annual subscription required (free users cannot access any features)
- Includes unlimited conversions, 40,000+ premium frames and growing, all future updates
- Students and teachers can get free 1-year Pro subscription at https://qrdyai.com/studentpack

**How to Use:**
1. Install Image to Frames app in Canva
2. Choose method: tap image in design, upload file, or import from library
3. Click convert - fully automatic
4. Use frame in Canva design

**Important Notes:**
- Frames downloaded from library must be imported into Image to Frames app in Canva (not just uploaded as regular file)
- Supports PNG, SVG, and JPG formats
- Conversion is fully automatic - no manual tracing or editing needed

## About NoteMe

NoteMe is a note-taking and reminder system that helps users capture everything they need to remember in one place. Users can create notes from mobile app, Canva, or automation workflows (n8n), and access them all from the mobile app.

**Key Features:**
- Create notes and reminders with AI assistance
- Mobile app (iOS, Android, Web) for quick note-taking
- Canva App integration for project notes (Pro required)
- n8n integration for automated note creation
- Tag organization and powerful search
- Calendar view for reminders
- Cross-platform sync

**Platforms:**
- Mobile App: iOS, Android, Web at https://noteme.qrdyai.com
- Canva App: Available in Canva (Pro subscription required)
- n8n Integration: Automate note creation from workflows

## About Text to Frames

Text to Frames is a Canva app that turns any word into Canva frames, one frame per letter, so users can fill text with an image or pattern. It supports custom fonts, borders, and blur effects, and keeps the letters editable as real frames.

**Key Features:**
- Convert any word into letter-shaped frames in one step
- Fill text with images or patterns by dropping a photo into the letters
- Choose any font and weight before converting
- Add borders around letters and blur to the image inside
- Faster alternative to the manual frame/clipping-mask method

### Main Documentation Pages - Text to Frames
- /text-to-frames/what-is-text-to-frames : Introduction to Text to Frames - what it is, what you can do, and why use it
- /text-to-frames/how-to-fill-text-with-image-canva : Step-by-step guide to fill text with an image in Canva using letter frames, plus the manual method, fonts, borders, and blur

**Primary Keywords:**
- how to fill text with image in canva
- fill text with image canva
- image in text canva
- text to frames

## About Calendar Maker

Calendar Maker is a Canva app that generates a calendar for any month, year, or custom date range in seconds. Users can create monthly, weekly, and yearly calendars, build printable calendars (including 2026), then customize and print them.

**Key Features:**
- Generate accurate calendar grids for any month or year
- Custom date ranges, not just full months
- Monthly, weekly, and yearly layouts
- Printable calendars to customize and print at home or order

### Main Documentation Pages - Calendar Maker
- /calendar-maker/what-is-calendar-maker : Introduction to Calendar Maker - what it is, what you can do, and why use it
- /calendar-maker/how-to-make-calendar-in-canva : Step-by-step guide to make a calendar in Canva, generate custom date ranges, build a printable 2026 calendar, and print

**Primary Keywords:**
- canva calendar maker
- how to create a calendar in canva
- printable monthly calendar 2026
- custom calendar maker
